findings.evidence: The helper says to "bump `rubric_version`" and then "Finish with ... rubric-check ... passing", but its preceding fetch can advance SOURCE.json.sha and no helper step updates rubric.spec_sha. That assignment occurs only later in the caller's workflow, so the helper's required check can fail before control returns; its version bump can also be repeated by the caller.
findings.fix: After repairing the mapping and fixtures, return the latest fetcher JSON to the main workflow and resume Source 1 steps 3–6. Perform the BASE comparison, rule classification, spec_sha update and any single version bump there, then build and run rubric-check plus the fetch-spec test. Remove the helper's independent version bump and premature final-check gate.

findings.evidence: "Read each changed page (or, in step 2, each page of a stale kind)" excludes stale-only kinds whenever changed is non-empty. For example, changed=["skills"] with profiles_stale=["command","agent"] reviews the command page but skips the interrupted agent review, leaving rubric-check failing without a specified review path.
findings.fix: Always review the union of changed pages and pages belonging to every profiles_stale kind: command maps to skills plus plugins-reference; agent maps to sub-agents plus plugins-reference. Deduplicate that union and compare all its pages before updating any affected profile digest.

findings.evidence: "A validator-only change is a rule change" conflicts with step 4's distinction between changed validator checks and editorial changes. A comment-only or formatting-only validator diff enters this branch without changing any validation rule.
findings.fix: Replace the blanket statement with: "Docs and the validator both require review. A validator-only change must not take the unchanged early return; changed validation behavior is a rule change, while comment-only or formatting-only changes are editorial and update spec_sha without bumping rubric_version."
